main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess next-day return

statistic.name: day-clustered t of the weighted mean

main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2 (and top-minus-bottom third > 0); reject: negative with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top third minus bottom third mean excess next-day return

decided_by: The weighted mean excess return is positive with t >= 2 and the top third beats the bottom third.
reading: Situation bars are bars where the recorded scaled return (recomputed from prices if missing) is below 0, on the long side; the t is a day-clustered t of the weighted mean (per-day sums of w*(x-mean), with G/(G-1) correction); thirds are split by sorted forecast with np.array_split and compared on unweighted mean excess returns; the plan's minimum of 100 cases on 60 days is applied as 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.00483 on the check folds against +0.01098 on every fold
